subject: Search for speaker(s) for R and Hadoop session at JSM

messages.author: 7dd5a5ca49c5ce80
messages.subject: Search for speaker(s) for R and Hadoop session at JSM
parts:
Hello all,

I'm trying to put together a topic-contributed session
http://www.amstat.org/meetings/jsm/2012/topiccontributed.cfm at next
year's Joint Statistical Meetings (first week of August in San Diego)
on using R with Hadoop. I have someone who can talk about writing
basic streaming jobs in R, think I can get someone to talk about using
Revolution's RHadoop project, and I'd love to have someone give an
example of using RHIPE.

If you're interested and are pretty sure you can get to JSM next year,
please contact me. If you know someone else who might be interested,
I'd love to be introduced. Remember, it's usually easier to get budget
to go to conferences if you're giving a talk. ;)

Thanks!
Melissa Santos
Statistical Analyst, Return Path
